services.desc: Our hearts go out to all those affected by hurricane Lala. As our family, friends and neighbors are steadfastly recovering from the wide spread effects of the storm, we want to give back to the community by offering a free companion ticket to this Friday’s show. Hilo Boy and 4x Grammy Award winner Kalani Pe’a returns to the Palace stage celebrating the 10-year anniversary of his debut album (E Walea), joined by a live band and spectacular hula performances. In hopes of relieving some of the stress from this week, Get one free companion ticket for each ticket purchased. Invite a family member, friend or neighbor to experience a night of incredible Hawaiian music. See offer redemption details
